name: dsh-deploy-gate
description: Deployment gate for DeepSeek Harness: turn 'deploy' from a human typing commands into a gated process with evidence — a release plan computed from what the suite already knows, a go/no-go verdict, human approval for production, host-configured commands executed as argv (never a shell), post-deploy verification, and a declared rollback path — all recorded in a repo-local ledger.
